h2: Online NDT courses: what they cover, what they cannot, and how to finish the job
html:
Online NDT courses have become the normal way to cover method theory in the US. They fit around shift work, nobody has to travel, and under ASNT SNT-TC-1A the hours count toward the formal training a written practice requires. What they cannot do on their own is certify anyone, and the searches for NDT certification online often miss that point.

What online NDT training covers

Good online NDT training covers the physics of the method, the equipment and its calibration, the techniques, the codes and acceptance criteria, and how to write a report, with quizzes and a final examination. A Level 2 online course (people search for an NDT Level 2 online course) adds setting up the technique, interpreting the results and writing instructions for Level I staff.

What it cannot cover

  • Hands-on practice. SNT-TC-1A expects practical training on real equipment and the practical examination on specimens with known discontinuities. No browser course replaces that.
  • Experience hours. The supervised hours in the method are earned on the job, after or alongside the course.
  • Certification. The employer certifies under its written practice, or the candidate sits ASNT central certification. A course certificate records training; it is not the certification.

How the Atlantis course closes those gaps

Theory is self-paced on the Atlantis portal and opens the moment you enrol, with an ASNT NDT Level III answering questions. Before the hands-on stage, candidates practise in the Practical NDT simulator, which records each step of the inspection so the instructor can review it. The hands-on practical then takes place at the employer's own facility, on its parts and procedures. For employers we can run the general, specific and practical examinations and prepare the records under a written practice built on SNT-TC-1A, and help write that written practice if one does not exist yet.

Which course first

Most technicians start with Level 1 training in visual testing, penetrant or magnetic particle testing, then add ultrasonic testing: see ultrasonic testing training. Experienced technicians move up with NDT Level 2 training. Try a method in the free practice tests first, check the SNT-TC-1A eligibility rules, and compare every route on the NDT training page.
